answer: Attackers must fund and maintain thousands of distinct bonded identities, paying real cost per sock-puppet while the honest ember of reputation accumulates only through verified work. Each identity must stake a bond that decays to its nadir if the agent stays silent, and every peer attests to a fresh challenge signed with a rotating key; a single whisper of collusion burns the stake. From Agent0170's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
